history.created_by: /bin/sh -c #(nop) ARG MYSQL_SERVER_PACKAGE MYSQL_SHELL_PACKAGE http_proxy https_proxy no_proxy

|2 MYSQL_SERVER_PACKAGE=mysql-community-server-minimal-9.7.3 MYSQL_SHELL_PACKAGE=mysql-shell-26.7.1 /bin/sh -c microdnf update && echo "[main]" > /etc/dnf/dnf.conf   && microdnf install -y --enablerepo=mysql-tools-innovation-community $MYSQL_SHELL_PACKAGE   && microdnf install -y --disablerepo=ol9_appstream    --enablerepo=mysql-9.7-lts-community-minimal $MYSQL_SERVER_PACKAGE   && microdnf remove -y $(rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME} ' 'mysql*-release*')   && microdnf clean all   && mkdir /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d

RUN /bin/sh -c microdnf update -y     && microdnf remove -y mysql-shell     && microdnf clean all     && test "$(rpm -q --qf '%{VERSION}' mysql-community-server-minimal)" = 9.7.3     && ! command -v mysqlsh     && mysqld --version && mysql --version && mysqldump --version # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c sha256sum /usr/sbin/mysqld > /tmp/mysql-engine.sha256     && rpm -qa | grep -v '^libevent-' | sort > /tmp/packages.before     && microdnf update -y libevent     && microdnf clean all     && sha256sum -c /tmp/mysql-engine.sha256     && rpm -qa | grep -v '^libevent-' | sort > /tmp/packages.after     && test "$(cat /tmp/packages.before)" = "$(cat /tmp/packages.after)"     && test "$(rpm -q --qf '%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}' libevent)" = 2.1.13-1.el9_8     && test "$(rpm -q --qf '%{VERSION}' mysql-community-server-minimal)" = 9.7.3     && rm /tmp/mysql-engine.sha256 /tmp/packages.before /tmp/packages.after     && mysqld --version # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c sha256sum /usr/sbin/mysqld > /tmp/mysql-engine.sha256     && rpm -qa | grep -vE '^(curl|libcurl)-' | sort > /tmp/packages.before     && microdnf update -y curl libcurl     && microdnf clean all     && sha256sum -c /tmp/mysql-engine.sha256     && rpm -qa | grep -vE '^(curl|libcurl)-' | sort > /tmp/packages.after     && test "$(cat /tmp/packages.before)" = "$(cat /tmp/packages.after)"     && test "$(rpm -q --qf '%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}' curl)" = 7.76.1-40.el9_8.7     && test "$(rpm -q --qf '%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}' libcurl)" = 7.76.1-40.el9_8.7     && test "$(rpm -q --qf '%{VERSION}' mysql-community-server-minimal)" = 9.7.3     && rm /tmp/mysql-engine.sha256 /tmp/packages.before /tmp/packages.after     && mysqld --version # buildkit
